title: DemoCreate: Declarative Audio-Visual Demo Generation for Software
description: DemoCreate generates inspectable demo artifacts from declarative scenes, narration and actions. Kokoro and system TTS are implemented optional voices; ffmpeg is required for MP4. Default synchronization measures clip duration and interpolates known text, not acoustic word onsets. Whisper, Chatterbox and Manim remain unwired slots. Version 0.8.0 is a release candidate pending publication; no final version archive DOI or release date is asserted.
